**Serves** {{< meta servings >}} · **Active** {{< meta active-time >}} · **Total** {{< meta total-time >}}

Made for Thanksgiving in a 26 cm (10¼ in) cast-iron skillet. It bakes covered
until the centre is hot, then uncovered at high heat to crisp the top. It can
be assembled in the morning and baked later.

## Ingredients

- 400 g sturdy country loaf or sourdough, cut into 2 cm cubes
- 320 g (0.7 lb) turkey sausage, out of the casing
- 55 g (4 tbsp) unsalted butter, plus more for the skillet
- 210 g (1 large) onion, diced
- 120 g (2 stalks) celery, diced
- 90 g (½) tart apple, diced (optional)
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 9 g (¼ cup) chopped fresh sage
- 3 g (1 tbsp) fresh thyme leaves
- 9 g (⅓ cup) chopped parsley
- 520 g (2¼ cups) warm chicken stock
- 2 eggs
- ½ tsp kosher salt, divided
- ½ tsp black pepper

## Method

1. Spread the bread on a sheet pan and dry at 300 °F until crisp all the way
   through, about 35 min.
2. Brown the sausage in the skillet over medium-high, breaking it up, until
   well coloured, about 8 min. Move it to a large bowl. Leave any fat in the
   pan.
3. Add the butter, onion, celery, apple, and half the salt. Cook until soft
   with browned edges, about 10 min.
4. Add the garlic, sage, and thyme for the last minute. Deglaze with a splash
   of the stock.
5. Add the vegetables, bread, parsley, the rest of the salt, and the pepper to
   the bowl with the sausage.
6. Whisk the eggs into the rest of the stock. Pour over the bread mixture, toss,
   and rest 10 min. A handful should hold together and feel damp with no liquid
   pooling in the bowl. If it's dry, add stock 50 g (3 tbsp) at a time.
7. Wipe out the skillet and butter it. Pack the stuffing in loosely; it will
   mound above the rim. Dot the top with butter.
8. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F until the centre reads 165 °F, 40–45 min.
9. Uncover, raise the oven to 425 °F, and bake until the top is deep golden,
   about 15 min.

## Notes

- To make ahead, cover the packed skillet and refrigerate after step 7. A cold
  skillet adds 5–10 min to the covered bake.
- Sausage and boxed stock are both salty. Taste the cooked vegetables before
  adding more salt.
